set.body:
Outcome

Expose one audited Alder-owned path from Data[Use.Unsplit] to complete-resampler evaluation/search, so ScalaFIM can run exact LORO without retagging data, package-private access, dummy holdouts, or duplicated fit/evaluation lifecycle.

Acceptance

- Alder owns nonempty training-population admission.
- CompleteResampler size, seed, and population receipt checks remain active.
- Search fits each analysis fold and scores only its assessment fold.
- JVM and JS tests prove empty rejection and exact-once evaluation.
- ScalaFIM pins the exact published Alder commit.
set.title: P4A.4a: add whole-population complete-resampling admission to Alder
